meta.title: Create an account | Izacki
meta.description: Create a free Izacki account: it works on the site, on the forum and in the Launcher.

forumSignup.title: Create an account
forumSignup.usernameRules: 3 to 24 characters, letters, digits or underscores, no spaces or accents, with at least one capital letter.
forumSignup.displayNameHint: The name shown to other players. You can change it later; otherwise your username is used.
forumSignup.legal: The terms of use and the privacy policy are in
forumSignup.created: Account created. Confirm your email address with the message we just sent you.
forumSignup.errEmailUsed: This email is already in use.
forumSignup.errRateLimit: Too many recent sign-ups (email sending limit). Try again in a few minutes.
forumSignup.errDisabled: Sign-ups are temporarily closed. Try again later or contact us.
forumSignup.errGeneric: The account could not be created. Try again.
forumSignup.okConnected: Account created and logged in. You are being taken to the forum.
forumSignup.okNeedsConfirm: Account created. Check your inbox (and your spam folder) to confirm your email address, then log in.
